text:
Ellery & Vane has bought the rights to *The Glass Cartographer*, the publisher confirmed on 14 March 2025.

The company acquired world English-language rights under a signed rights agreement, announced in a joint press statement issued at the Halvorsen Book Fair. The advance was reported to be $425,000.

Marguerite Odell, acquisitions director at Ellery & Vane, negotiated the deal.

"We are delighted to bring *The Glass Cartographer* to readers around the world," Odell said. "It is a book we believed in from the first reading, and this agreement lets us give it the platform it deserves."

The statement did not give a publication date. Further details are expected from the publisher in the coming weeks.
